#Nifty daily read for 9 Sep, 2026.

Red day for Nifty continues, continous selling pressure throughout the day.. All technicals look bearish, a further downside could be expected from here before a bounce back. 

Read our full trading brief here 👉 
https://t.co/6zfRt351iB

A small bounce happened from the 23,625 level in the second half of the session, so that level needs to be actively monitored.

FIIs were neutral, but DIIs continue to be net buyers. The buying might have happened more in the broader market than Nifty, as Midcap & Smallcap indices closed green today.

FIIs' Call shorts to Put shorts ratio at 2.4 suggests heavy call writing, especially at the 23,800 & 24,000 levels. These could act as strong resistance zones.

On the downside, heavy put writing was seen at 23,200 & 23,000 levels for Sep 15 (Tuesday) expiry. Writers appear to expect a test of those levels but see them as support.
